verdict.rationale: The quickstart states that every new E2B account gets $100 in credits. The docs also reference a Base tier (1-hour sessions) alongside Pro, and onboarding is self-serve through an API key and SDK quickstart, with no sales step. Missing for 10: an explicit statement that signup needs no sales contact, detailed limits for the Base/free tier on the pricing page, and independent or hands-on confirmation of the credit grant.
